Antill Assistant Professor of Business Administration Assistant Professor of Business Administration Samuel Antill is an assistant professor of business administration in the Finance Unit at Harvard Business School. He teaches the Finance II course in the MBA required curriculum. Professor Antill’s research studies how firms’ interactions with the U.S. legal system affect firms and their stakeholders. Most of his work examines the U.S. corporate bankruptcy system. He also studies related topics such as corporate litigation. Professor Antill earned a PhD in Finance from the Stanford Graduate School of Busines
